show.description: What happens when love, property, and inheritance collide in a traditional Indian family? Joint Family is an emotional rollercoaster that uncovers the ugly truths behind fake smiles, revealing the heartbreak of aging parents caught in their children’s games. Dive into this powerful drama of betrayal, ego, and survival. Watch Now!
